current.text: Isaiah Jackson is starting over Lopez at center in Clippers preseason scrimmages. This is not guaranteed to continue.
Lopez is 38 and in the final year of his contract.
Konan Niederhauser, the other Clippers center, is injured and out.
He projects as the backup center in a mentoring role, behind Isaiah Jackson in the projected lineup.
He played only 23 minutes a night last season, partly because Ivica Zubac was there. Zubac has since been traded.
Do not take him inside the top 200. His ESPN rank of 112 and ADP of 109 are too high.
At 30 minutes a night he would be a late-round draftable player. If his minutes are split down to about 22, he has no fantasy value.
Coach Ty Lue makes odd rotation choices and then changes them. The Clippers also expect a trial season with long rotations, so Lopez's minutes are hard to predict.
The Clippers have a good fantasy playoff schedule: 4, 3 and 4 games in weeks 19 to 21. They have one of the lowest back-to-back totals in the league with 13.

durable.text: He is past his peak and his production dropped off badly last season.
His free throw shooting fell sharply last season.
He still contests shots at the rim but struggles defending the pick and roll.
For a center he makes many threes and commits few turnovers. Blocks are his best category. Rebounds and steals are weak for a center.

note: Lopez is priced at 0 USD on Yahoo and 2 USD on ESPN, and nobody drafted him in our league last season. He finished 250th last season and the newest expert call is to avoid him inside the top 200, so he should not be one of the 144 players drafted in our auction.
